content.short: Bridge is a stablecoin platform for developers, handling issuance, conversion and global payouts.
content.description: Bridge gives developers APIs for moving money with stablecoins, covering fiat conversion, issuance and cross-border payouts without each company assembling its own banking relationships. Monad's documentation lists it under onramps and payment orchestrators. Stripe's acquisition of the company in 2024 was a fairly direct signal about where mainstream payments infrastructure expects stablecoins to sit.
